title: PolarisDesktopAvailability
description: The one availability model every Phase-01 surface uses. A feature that is not built yet is a first-class state with a machine reason, never an empty screen and never free text.
$comment: نموذج الإتاحة الوحيد. الحالة والسبب رمزان مغلقان، والنصّ المعروض تُوطّنه الواجهة من الرمز. لا سبب حرّ يحمل سلطة.

AvailabilityState.title: AvailabilityState
AvailabilityState.description: Closed availability state. AVAILABLE means usable now; READ_ONLY means observable but not actionable; UNAVAILABLE means absent by design in this phase; BLOCKED means a prerequisite is unmet; ERROR means the host could not determine it.

AvailabilityReason.title: AvailabilityReason
AvailabilityReason.description: Closed machine reason. The UI localises display text from state + reason; localized prose never enters the contract.

Availability.title: Availability

allOf.$comment: المتاح لا يحمل سببًا: سبب على AVAILABLE يجعل الحقل زخرفة ويُغري الواجهة بعرضه.
كل حالة غير AVAILABLE توجب سببًا مصنّفًا. «غير متاح» بلا سبب هو شاشة فارغة بلغة أخرى.

Availability.description: A state, and a machine reason whenever the state is not AVAILABLE.

CapabilityAvailability.title: CapabilityAvailability
CapabilityAvailability.description: Availability of one capability, as the host determined it. The renderer never computes this from a build-time constant.
